title: TI-83 Plus and Arduino Sensor Lab
summary: Restore a TI-83 Plus, learn TI-BASIC, graph sensor observations, connect an Arduino bridge, and distinguish an action request from authorized execution.

adult_only_tasks: Remove leaking batteries and complete the initial residue cleanup.
Verify electrical protection for the TI link interface.

stages.title: Restore the calculator
objectives: Observe how batteries supply a circuit.
Document restoration without overstating operational proof.
stages.safety_gate: An adult removes leaking batteries and completes initial cleanup before learner handling.

stages.title: Make the calculator behave
objectives: Use variables, input, conditionals and output.
Produce and explain both allowed and denied outcomes.
stages.safety_gate: Programs remain simulations and do not control physical loads.

stages.title: Graph sensor observations
objectives: Collect a short series of physical measurements.
Graph data and describe uncertainty or limitations.
stages.safety_gate: Use low-voltage sensors only; MQ-2 results are never treated as a certified safety alarm.

stages.title: Build the Arduino/TI bridge
objectives: Distinguish sensor acquisition, translation, transfer and interpretation.
Transfer a validated value or list to the calculator.
stages.safety_gate: An adult verifies a protected link interface; sensors never connect directly to the calculator port.

stages.title: Govern a low-voltage action
objectives: Distinguish an action proposal from execution authority.
Demonstrate one allowed and one refused low-voltage LED request.
stages.safety_gate: Only an isolated battery-powered LED load is permitted; household voltage is excluded.

non_capture_note: This path provides adaptable learning opportunities and must not be used as a fixed learner identity, ranking, destiny, or autonomous permission.
